input.message: B1 displayed TRK-99. What does that code mean?

input.message: Cooling pump A2 has press alarm E217. Use that code to diagnose it.

input.message: A2 is at 8.4 mm/s. Prior notes say that is acceptable; can it keep running?

input.message: B1 has TRK-04. Is the tension sensor definitely the cause?

retrieved_documents.content: TRK-04 can result from tension feedback outside range, guide offset, or contamination.
A synthetic prior TRK-04 with similar drift was traced to a blocked photoeye, not a tension sensor.
